scope: OFFLINE PROTOTYPE: bounded structured intents; no LLM, no portal, no production promotion

tool_selection_accuracy.definition: Correct deterministic routing / supported structured-intent cases; not natural-language accuracy.

numeric_grounding_rate.definition: Whole result equals existing core / supported cases; shared algorithm, not independent validation.

source_grounding_rate.definition: Declared source identifiers resolve in catalog / supported cases; not completeness of every field provenance.

followup_recalculation_rate.definition: Follow-ups triggering execution and critic recalculation / follow-up cases.

out_of_scope_rejection_rate.definition: Unsupported explicit intents with no tool / unsupported cases.

critic_detection_rate.definition: Injected corruptions/unapproved free-text drafts rejected / injections. This is template allowlisting, not general semantic detection.

determinism_rate.definition: Byte-equivalent canonical complete session results / repeated identical structured requests.
